core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aaqif corresponds to the Arabic form عاكف (Arabic root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f); عَاكِف (ʿākif)). Its core sense is devoted, steadfast; staying. Aaqif is Arabic عَاكِف (ʿākif) 'Devoted, steadfast, staying', the active participle of عَكَفَ (ʿakafa, 'to stay, to devote oneself') from the root ع ك ف (ʿ-k-f).
